# Bounce Method

> Bounce Method is a basketball vertical jump training program for athletes. It trains strength, power, elasticity, speed and jump mechanics together in a simple weekly plan. The program has not launched yet; visitors can sign up on the homepage to be notified when it is released.

## Site

- [Home](https://bouncemethod.net/): Program overview, the five-part Bounce Formula, the weekly schedule, who it's for, and the sign-up form for release updates.
- [Blog](https://bouncemethod.net/blog/): Vertical jump training articles for basketball players.

## Articles

- [How to jump higher for basketball](https://bouncemethod.net/blog/how-to-jump-higher-for-basketball/): The 5 qualities that decide your vertical, a sample week, how long it takes, common mistakes, and how to measure your vertical.

## Program overview

- The Bounce Formula: 01 Strength, 02 Power, 03 Elasticity, 04 Speed, 05 Jump mechanics. The key is training all five together.
- The week: 4 training days, 1 recovery day, 2 rest days.
  - Mon: Force Day (lower body strength, high intensity)
  - Tue: Tendon, Ankle + Balance (lower intensity)
  - Wed: Elasticity + Speed (high intensity)
  - Thu: Rest
  - Fri: Power + Max Jump (high intensity)
  - Sat: Durability Reset (light mobility and stability, lower intensity)
  - Sun: Rest
- Who it's for: middle school, high school, AAU and college players who want to dunk or get higher for rebounds, blocks and finishes. All levels; beginners can pick easier variations.

## Contact

- Sign up for updates or ask a question with the form on the [homepage](https://bouncemethod.net/#get-the-program). Under 18s should have a parent or guardian fill it out.
- TikTok and Instagram: @bounce.method

## Notes

- Results vary from athlete to athlete and depend on training experience, consistency, recovery and nutrition.
